v: strI ba॰ va॰ । Apa--kvip hrasvaSca । jale । “prattaM jalaM dvyaYjalamantike'pAm” BawwiH । “adBireva pArayitvA nEtyikAnte Bujikriyeti” smftiH agnerApaH, adByonnamiti SrutiH “apaeva sasarjjAdO tAsu vIjamavAsfjaditi” manuH । samAsAnte ac samAsAntaH । “bahvapAni taqAni sArasAH samupAsate” ityudBawaH । kftasamAsAntasya upasarga dvyantaHparasya AtaIttvam । samIpaMprepam dvIpaH antarIpam । anupUrvvAttu deSe vAcye Ut । anUpodeSaH anyatra anvIpogrAma ityAdi । pUjArTakasupUrvvAt na ac । svAmpi nagarARi । apAM vikAraH mayaw । ammayaH vA zyaY । Apyam । svArTe cAtu॰ zyaY । ApyaM jale na॰ ।
m: 1. अप् n. (gen. अपस्), work (according to NBD.), RV. i, 151, 4.
2. अप् f. (in Ved. used in sing. and pl., but in the classical language only in pl., आपस्) water
the Waters considered as divinities. ifc. अप् may become अप or ईप, ऊप after इ- and उ- stems respectively.
अप् [cf. Lat. aqua; Goth. ahva, ‘a river’; Old Germ. aha, and affa at the end of compounds; Lith. uppê, ‘a river’; perhaps Lat. amnis, ‘a river’, for apnis cf. also ἀϕρός]
a: अप् — f. [आप्-क्विप्-ह्रस्वश्च Uṇ. 2. 58] (Declined in classical language only in pl.; आपः, अपः, अद्भिः, अद्भ्यः अपां and अप्सु, but in singular and pl. in Veda) 1 Water (regarded in Ved. as sacred divinities, आपो देवीः); खानि चैव स्पृशेदद्भिः Ms. 2. 60. Water is generally considered to be the first of the 5 elements of creation, as in अप एव ससर्जादौ तासु बीजमवासृजत् Ms. 1. 8, Ś. 1. 1; but in Ms. 1. 78 it is said to have been created from ज्योतिस् or तेजस् after मनस्, आकाश, वायु and ज्योतिस् or अग्नि; ज्योतिषश्च विकुर्वाणादापो रसगुणाः स्मृताः . अद्भ्यो गंधगुणा भूमिरित्येषा सृष्टिरादितः .. --2 Air, the intermediate region. --3 The star Ś virginis. For the changes of अप् at the end of comp. see P. V. 4. 74, VI. 3. 97-98. [cf. L. aqua, Gr. appos; Lith. uppe; Goth. ahva; Pers. ab; Zend ap; Old Germ. aha]. --Comp. --कृत्स्नं deep meditation by means of water. --चरः an aquatic animal. --पतिः {1} ‘Lord of waters’, N. of Varuṇa. {2} the ocean. For other comps. see s. v.

k.v: आपः स्त्री भूम्नि वार्वारि सलिलं कमलं जलम्. पयः कीलालममृतं जीवनं भुवनं वनम्.।
